script_text: Stop! Aquarius, the Air-charged stars are screaming at you right now. This aspect demands you assert your independence while navigating close relationships. The friction can be electrifying, but also volatile if you ignore the undercurrents throughout your busy day. In your 10th House of career, Jupiter trines your Midheaven, heralding a surge of opportunities for professional advancement. A daring proposal or creative project could gain unexpected traction, so seize the moment. Avoid impulsive spending spurred by the Mars-Uranus clash; an unexpected gift of inspiration may arrive instead. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
